title: Where Can I Download a Farm Management App for Android?
metaTitle: Farm App for Android: Where to Get It and How to Install
metaDescription: Need a farm app for Android? Get rice apps on Google Play, or add anee.io to your home screen from Chrome. Steps, checks and costs here.
excerpt: You can download a farm app for Android from Google Play, where you will find rice apps such as the PalayCheck App and Binhing Palay. anee.io, a farm app built for Filipino farmers, works another way. It is a web app, so you open anee.io in Chrome and install it to your home screen. It then opens like any other app, offline mode included, but it is not in the Play Store.

heroImage.alt: A farm app for Android on three phone screens: Quick Capture taking a photo of the crop, Anee saying hello, and a farm map centred on the phone's location

blocks.text:
Most farmers look for apps in the Play Store first, and that works for many tools. But some farm apps, anee.io among them, are web apps. They live on the web and install from the browser instead of a store.

Both kinds run on Android phones. So the better question is whether an app fits your phone, your signal and your farm. Here is where to get farm apps, how to install anee.io step by step, and what to check before you install anything.
Key points

items: The main rice apps are on Google Play, and their maker's Rice Apps page also offers APK files.
anee.io is not in the Play Store. Open it in Chrome, log in, then choose Install from the menu.
Before you install any farm app, check its permissions, storage, offline use, data use and language.
anee.io's Libre plan is free, with a few ads. Paid plans start at PHP 70 a month.

blocks.text: Where can I download a farm management app for Android?
There are four ways a farm management app reaches an Android phone. Whichever way you choose, get the app from its maker.

blocks.text: On Google Play, the PalayCheck App shows a price of zero and more than 10,000 downloads. It builds a rice calendar from your variety and planting method, and it logs expenses and harvest. Our guide to the [best free farm app](/blog/free-farm-app-philippines) compares the free tools in more detail.
How do I install anee.io on an Android phone?
It takes about a minute with signal. These steps follow Google's own Chrome Help.

items.title: Open Chrome
items.text: Use Chrome on your Android phone, then type anee.io in the address bar.

items.title: Sign up or log in
items.text: Create a free account on the [sign up page](/signup), or log in. The app then opens on your own farm.

items.title: Tap the menu
items.text: Tap More, the three dots at the right end of the address bar.

items.title: Tap Install
items.text: Choose Install and create shortcut, then Install. The words can differ by phone, so look for Install or Add to Home screen if you do not see it.

items.title: Open it from your home screen
items.text: The anee.io icon now sits with your other apps. It opens in its own window, without the browser's address bar.

items.title: Open your season once with signal
items.text: anee.io then keeps your recent seasons on the phone, so the board opens in the field with no signal.

blocks.text: Offline mode is on for every plan, the free one too. You tick tasks and write notes in the paddy, and the changes sync when the signal returns. Our guide to a [farm app without internet](/blog/farm-app-without-internet) explains how that works.

blocks.title: Install APK files only from the maker
blocks.text: If your phone has no Google Play, an APK file is the other way in. Download it only from the maker's own page. Never install one that a stranger forwards in a group chat, because nobody can tell what someone changed inside it.

blocks.title: Put anee.io on your home screen
blocks.text: Sign up free in Chrome, then tap Install. Your season opens like any other app, even with no signal.
blocks.label: Start free

Read the store page or the website first. Then test the app for a week on one lot before you put the whole farm in it.

blocks.text: What Android permissions mean

Android Help lists the choices for camera, microphone and location. You can allow them only while you use the app, have the phone ask every time, or not allow them. To change a store app later, go to Settings, Apps, pick the app, then Permissions. For a web app, open Chrome's Settings, then Site settings.
Which farm apps do Filipino farmers use?
We found no official count of farm app users in the Philippines. So here are the kinds of apps farmers use, with examples you can check yourself.

items: **Rice advisory apps:** Binhing Palay, the PalayCheck App, the MOET app, the LCC app and the RCM Advisory Service all sit on one Rice Apps page.

**Planning and record apps:** they date the work and add up costs and harvests. anee.io is one, built for Filipino farmers, and our guide to the [best farm management app](/blog/farm-management-app-philippines) shows what to expect.
**Pest and disease photo apps:** you take a photo and get a likely cause. See our guide to the [plant disease identification app](/blog/plant-disease-identification-app).
**Weather apps:** forecasts, rain radar and typhoon warnings for your town.
**Chat and community apps:** where growers trade advice and prices with each other.

blocks.text: You do not need one app for everything. A rice farmer might keep the rice advisory apps for advice, a weather app for rain, and one app for the season's plan and records.
Is a web app as good as a Play Store app?

For daily farm work, it does the same job. It has an icon on your home screen, opens in its own window and keeps working offline. Still, there are two differences to know. First, you will not find anee.io by searching the Play Store. Second, offline changes that have not synced yet live in Chrome. So do not clear Chrome's data for anee.io before you reach signal.
Questions about farm apps for Android

items.q: Is anee.io on the Google Play Store?
items.a: No. anee.io is a web app, so you install it from Chrome instead. Open anee.io, log in, tap the menu and choose Install, and it sits on your home screen like any other app.

items.q: How do I remove a web app from my Android phone?
items.a: Google's Chrome Help says to open Settings, then Apps, then See all apps. Tap the web app and choose Uninstall. Sync your changes first, because records already synced stay in your account.

items.q: Do I need mobile data every day?
items.a: No. Offline mode keeps the board, notes and growth stages working without signal, on every plan. Your changes sync when you reach signal. Anee, the weather and the community still need a connection.

items.q: Can I use the same account on a computer?
items.a: Yes. anee.io runs in the browser of any phone, tablet or computer, and the same account works on each. You can plan on a laptop at home and tick tasks on the phone in the field.

items.q: Is it safe to install an APK file?
items.a: Only from the maker's own page, such as its official APK links. A file passed around in a chat group may not be the original. When in doubt, use the Play Store or a web app instead.
